title: Baat bi baña am yaakaar
intro: Duggal ci kër gu ñàkk gu topp ñàkk, waaye benn baat bu dal te baña ñàkka am yaakaar. Benn woote ci Al Qur'an dafay soppi muñ nekk jéego bu am solo; Ndax mën nga topp tegtal yi ci nit ki ci ginaaw baat boobu?
clues: Man maay baatu muñ ci biir kër gu musiba di natt barkeb Yàlla.
Ma des ci kër gu amul kenn ndax ñàkka am alal ak samay doom.
Xamoon naa ni feebar bi dafa dal sama àndadoo boobu itam, ndax yaram wi dafa mettiwoon lool.
Bi coono bi gënee tar, ma woote ak fàttali Yàlla.
Maa ngi wax benn yoon: Yàlla mooy Dëgg, kon muñleen.
Ma woo Ayyub ci turam; Ginaaw loolu Yàlla dindi na tiis wi, indiwaat famiy bi.

identity.label: Man Kan laa?
options: Soxna Seydina Ayyub
Jabar Yonent Nuh
Soxna Seydina Ibrahim
Soxna Yonent Ya'qub
Doom ju jigéen ju Firawna

trial.label: Jàngat/Xew-xew
options: Dese ak Ayyub ci ñàkk ak feebar, ba noppi woo mu muñ
Àrtu ab ndaw bu jub mu bàyyi askan wu yàqu
Ñaanal juddug mbokk ëlëg
Tekki ay gént ci biir kaso bu buur
Gis xale buñu wóolu ci wetu dex
trial.answer: Dese ak Ayyub ci ñàkk ak feebar, ba noppi woo mu muñ

location.label: Ëlëm bu am solo
options: Wax ni Yalla moy Dëgg ak muñ lay laaj
Garab palme ci wetu ndox mi
woote ngir tabax gaal gu sori ci vague yi
Geestu fukk ak benn biddiiw ak jant buy fenk
Basket bu ñuy yóbbu ci wetu dexu Nile
location.answer: Wax ni Yalla moy Dëgg ak muñ lay laaj

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Ayyub dindi nañu tiis wi, njabootam delluwaat
Xale buñu yàgg a xaar, ñu may ko ginaaw bi ñu ñaanee lu amul doom
Benn njiit bu ndaw dafa tekki juróom ñaari at yu bari ak ñàkk
Xale bu ñu wóolu lañu muccal ci ndox muy wal
Àrtu dafa jiitu mbënd buy yàq
outcome.answer: Ayyub dindi nañu tiis wi, njabootam delluwaat

verse: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire. (83:16)
